requirements.requirement: Approximately 250 words; headings Background/Objectives, Methods, Results, Conclusions
3 to 10 keywords
Introduction, Materials and Methods, Results, Discussion; Conclusions optional; full front/back matter
No maximum article length when concise and complete
Main findings and implications, at most two bullets in each group
Full first/last names; verified complete affiliations; normally one corresponding author; author email-display consent
Substantial contribution, intellectual drafting/review, final approval and accountability; true CRediT roles
Numeric order of first appearance; square brackets before punctuation; full titles; data/source-method attribution
Preferably no less than 600 dpi, PNG/JPEG/TIFF; RGB 8-bit per channel encouraged
Editable Word tables and equations, figures/tables near first citation in numeric order
If supplied, PNG/JPEG/TIFF; minimum 560 height by 1100 width pixels
Word single main file or compilable LaTeX ZIP; total submission files <=120 MB unless office consulted
Initial free-format manuscript allowed; required sections and complete consistent references retained; journal formatting at revision
Official templates for journal submission, not posting to preprint servers/other websites; independently styled draft can be shared
Significance, prior-work context, journal fit, no simultaneous/prior journal publication, all-author approval; prior MDPI history disclosed
Three independent potential reviewers, not same institution/current collaborators/no coauthor within last three years
Single-anonymized peer review
DAS with source and generated dataset access/restrictions; cite original study and dataset record
Human-data ethics and consent statements; exemption/legal basis if additional approval not required
Public anonymous EEG alone does not establish not-applicable; verify original approvals/consent/license and current secondary-use basis
True research/APC support, grants and COI; do not assume none
Substantive generation/design/analysis/interpretation disclosed at submission, Methods and Acknowledgments with tool details; authors accountable; AI not author
Superficial text editing can be exempt; this drafting/synthesis task is substantive use
CHF 2400 on acceptance, plus applicable tax; eligible discounts possible
Publish controls and sufficient replicable method/software/version/code details; supporting minimal dataset available
